skill_name: Given an article about politics, identify the main points and generate a corresponding infographic.
workflow:
Infographic: 

Major Reforms for the Healthcare System 

• Introduction of a new bill in Congress 
• Affordable healthcare plans 
• Focus on preventive care 
• Investment in community health centers 
• Mandates on health insurance 
• Expansion of Medicaid and coverage 
• Increased funding for VA hospitals
